Telescope Partners | Software Engineer | On-site US, San Francisco | Full-time

Telescope is an early stage growth VC firm with a focus on enterprise software companies. We're a small, efficient team, with a beautiful office in Presidio. We work closely with entrepreneurs and help them fill critical business functions as they grow. Our tech team is oriented at improving team efficiency: optimizing our business practices while actively replacing as much investor work and intelligence with automation as possible. If you're interested in PE and agents, this might be a good role for you!

To apply email mike at telescopepartners.com
